scope: Rescue step instructions. Compare each translation with its English source before approving it for the app.

steps.en: Call 112 immediately.

ha.text: Kira 112 nan da nan.

ig.text: Kpọọ 112 ozugbo.

yo.text: Pé 112 lẹ́sẹ̀kẹsẹ̀.

pcm.text: Abeg call 112 sharp sharp.

steps.en: If the person has an adrenaline (epinephrine) auto-injector (EpiPen), use it on the outer thigh immediately.

ha.text: Idan mutumin yana da na'urar allurar adrenaline (epinephrine) mai aiki da kanta (EpiPen), yi amfani da ita a wajen cinyarsa nan da nan.

ig.text: Ọ bụrụ na onye ahụ nwere ngwaọrụ ntụtụ adrenaline (epinephrine) akpaghị aka (EpiPen), jiri ya tụọ ya n'apata ụkwụ mpụta ozugbo.

yo.text: Tí ẹni náà bá ní abẹ́rẹ́ adrenaline (epinephrine) aládásílẹ̀ (EpiPen), lò ó sì ìta ìtàn lẹ́sẹ̀kẹsẹ̀.

pcm.text: If di person get adrenaline (epinephrine) auto-injector (EpiPen), use am for di outside part of dia thigh immediately.

steps.en: Lay the person flat with their legs elevated. If breathing is difficult, let them sit up slightly.

ha.text: Kwantar da mutumin ya kwanta a kwance tare da ɗaga ƙafafunsa. Idan numfashi yana da wahala, a bar shi ya ɗan zauna a ɗage.

ig.text: Dina onye ahụ ala ma bulie ụkwụ ya elu. Ọ bụrụ na iku ume siri ike, hapụ ya ka ọ nọdụ ntakịrị.

yo.text: Jẹ́ kí ẹni náà dùbúlẹ̀ pélébé pẹ̀lú ẹsẹ̀ rẹ tí a gbé sókè. Bí mímí bá ń sọ̀rọ̀, jẹ́ kí ó jókòó díẹ̀.

pcm.text: Make the person lie flat and raise their legs. If breathing hard, make dem sit up small.

steps.en: Remove or avoid the trigger allergen if still present (e.g. remove a bee stinger).

ha.text: Cire ko guji abin da ke haifar da rashin lafiyan idan har yana nan (misali, cire ƙugin zuma).

ig.text: Wepụ ma ọ bụ zere ihe na-akpata nfụkasị ahụ ma ọ bụrụ na ọ ka dị (dịka ọmụmaatụ, wepụ ọdụ aesụ).

yo.text: Yọ tàbí yàgò fún nkan tí ó fa àléjì náà tí ó bá ṣi wá (fún àpẹẹrẹ, yọ abẹ́rẹ́ oyin kan).

pcm.text: Comot or avoid the allergen wey trigger am if e still dey there (for example, comot bee sting).

steps.en: If unconscious and not breathing, begin CPR immediately.

ha.text: Idan ba shi da hayyaci kuma baya numfashi, fara CPR nan da nan.

ig.text: Ọ bụrụ na onye ahụ amaghị onwe ya ma anaghị eku ume, bido CPR ozugbo.

yo.text: Tí ẹni náà bá dákú àti pé kò ń mí, bẹ̀rẹ̀ CPR lẹ́sẹ̀kẹsẹ̀.

pcm.text: If dem no dey conscious and no dey breathe, start CPR immediately.

steps.en: If a second EpiPen is available and no improvement in 5 minutes, use it.

ha.text: Idan akwai EpiPen na biyu kuma babu sauƙi bayan minti 5, yi amfani da shi.

ig.text: Ọ bụrụ na EpiPen nke abụọ dị ma enweghị mmezi n'ime nkeji 5, jiri ya.

yo.text: Bí EpiPen kejì bá wa tí kò sì sí imuniròsí lẹ́yìn ìṣẹ́jú márùn-ún, lò ó.

pcm.text: If second EpiPen dey and no improvement after 5 minutes, use am.

steps.en: Help the person sit or lie down in a comfortable position.

ha.text: Taimaka wa mutumin ya zauna ko ya kwanta a wuri mai daɗi.

ig.text: Nyere onye ahụ aka ịnọdụ ala ma ọ bụ dinara n’ọnọdụ dị ya mma.

yo.text: Ràn ẹni náà lọ́wọ́ láti jókòó tàbí dùbúlẹ̀ ní ipò tó rọrùn.

pcm.text: Help the person siddon or lie down for comfortable position.

steps.en: Loosen any tight clothing around the neck and chest.

ha.text: Sake duk wani matsattsen sutura a wuyan da ƙirji.

ig.text: Tọpụ uwe ọ bụla siri ike n’olu na n’obi.

yo.text: Tú aṣọ tí ó mú ní àyíká ọrùn àti àyà wọn sílẹ̀.

pcm.text: Comot any tight cloth wey dey around your neck and chest.

steps.en: If the person has prescribed nitroglycerin, help them take it.

ha.text: Idan an rubuta wa mutumin nitroglycerin, taimaka masa ya sha.

ig.text: Ọ bụrụ na edepụtara nitroglycerin maka onye ahụ, nyere ha aka ịṅụ ya.

yo.text: Tí wọ́n bá ti fún ẹni náà ní nitroglycerin, ràn wọ́n lọ́wọ́ láti mú un.

pcm.text: If person get nitroglycerin wey doctor prescribe, help dem take am.

steps.en: Keep them calm and still. Do not let them walk around.

ha.text: Ka sa shi ya kwantar da hankali kuma ya zauna ba tare da motsi ba. Kada ka bar shi ya yi yawo.

ig.text: Mee ka ha nọrọ jụụ ma ghara imegharị. Ekwela ka ha gagharịa gburugburu.

yo.text: Jẹ́ kí wọ́n balẹ̀ kí wọ́n sì dúró ṣinṣin. Má jẹ́ kí wọ́n máa rìn káàkiri.

pcm.text: Make dem stay calm and siddon still. No let dem waka around.

steps.en: If pain does not improve within 15 minutes, call emergency services immediately.

ha.text: Idan ciwon bai sauƙaƙa cikin minti 15 ba, kira ayyukan gaggawa nan da nan.

ig.text: Ọ bụrụ na mgbu adịghị akwụsị n’ime nkeji iri na ise, kpọọ ndị ọrụ mberede ozugbo.

yo.text: Tí ìrora kò bá dínkù láàrin ìṣẹ́jú 15, pé àwọn iṣẹ́ pàjáwìrì lẹ́sẹ̀kẹsẹ̀.

pcm.text: If pain no better within 15 minutes, call emergency services sharp sharp.

steps.en: Keep the person calm and help them sit upright. Do not let them lie down.

ha.text: Ka kwantar wa mutumin hankali kuma ka taimaka masa ya zauna a tsaye. Kada ka bar shi ya kwanta.

ig.text: Mee ka onye ahụ dị jụụ ma nyere ya aka ịnọdụ ala kwụ ọtọ. Ekwela ka ọ dina ala.

yo.text: Jẹ́ kí ẹni náà balẹ̀, kí ó sì rán an lọ́wọ́ láti jókòó sókè. Má jẹ́ kí ó dùbúlẹ̀.

pcm.text: Make the person calm and help am siddon upright. No let am lie down.

steps.en: Help them use their reliever inhaler (usually blue). Give 1 puff every 30–60 seconds, up to 10 puffs.

ha.text: Taimaka musu su yi amfani da inhaler ɗinsu na sauƙaƙa numfashi (yawanci mai launin shuɗi). A ba su feshi 1 duk bayan daƙiƙa 30–60, har zuwa feshi 10.

ig.text: Nyere ya aka iji inhaler enyemaka ya (nke na-adịkarị acha anụnụ anụnụ). Nye otu puff kwa sekọnd 30–60, ruo puff 10.

yo.text: Ràn wọ́n lọ́wọ́ láti lo afẹ́fẹ́ ìrànlọ́wọ́ wọn (tí ó sábà máa ń jẹ́ aláwọ̀ búlúù). Fún wọn ní fífẹ̀ kan ní gbogbo ìṣẹ́jú àáyá 30–60, títí dé fífẹ̀ mẹ́wàá.

pcm.text: Help dem use dia reliever inhaler (normally blue). Give 1 puff every 30–60 seconds, reach 10 puffs.

steps.en: If they do not have their inhaler, call 112 immediately.

ha.text: Idan ba su da inhaler nasu, kira 112 nan da nan.

ig.text: Ọ bụrụ na ha enweghị inhaler ha, kpọọ 112 ozugbo.

yo.text: Tí wọn kò bá ní afẹ́fẹ́ ìrànlọ́wọ́ wọn, pé 112 lẹ́sẹ̀kẹsẹ̀.

pcm.text: If dem no get dia inhaler, call 112 immediately.

steps.en: Stay with them. If they are not better after 15 minutes, call 112.

ha.text: Ka zauna tare da shi. Idan bai ji sauƙi ba bayan minti 15, kira 112.

ig.text: Nọnyere ha. Ọ bụrụ na ahụ erughị ha ala mgbe nkeji iri na ise gachara, kpọọ 112.

yo.text: Dúró pẹ̀lú wọn. Bí wọn kò bá yá lẹ́yìn ìṣẹ́jú 15, pé 112.

pcm.text: Stay with dem. If dem no better after 15 minutes, call 112.

steps.en: If they become unconscious and stop breathing, begin CPR.

ha.text: Idan sun suma kuma suka daina numfashi, fara CPR.

ig.text: Ọ bụrụ na ọ maghị onwe ya ma kwụsị iku ume, bido CPR.

yo.text: Tí wọ́n bá dákú, tí wọ́n sì dá mímí dúró, bẹ̀rẹ̀ CPR.

pcm.text: If dem lose consciousness and stop to breathe, start CPR.

steps.en: Keep the person still and calm. Do not attempt to move them if a spine injury is possible.

ha.text: Ka sa mutum ya zauna lafiya ba tare da motsi ba. Kada ka yi ƙoƙarin motsa shi idan akwai yiwuwar raunin kashin baya.

ig.text: Mee ka onye ahụ nọrọ jụụ ma ghara imegharị. Anwala ibugharị ha ma ọ bụrụ na o nwere ike ịbụ mmerụ ọkpụkpụ azụ.

yo.text: Jẹ́ kí ẹni náà dúró jẹ́ẹ́, kí ó sì balẹ̀. Má ṣe gbìyànjú láti gbé e tí ó bá ṣeé ṣe kí opa-ìfín rẹ fara pa.

pcm.text: Make the person no move and make dem calm. No try move dem if e fit be say dem spine don injure.

steps.en: Immobilise the injured limb in the position you find it — use a splint made from stiff material (wood, rolled newspaper) padded with cloth.

ha.text: Ka tsayar da gaɓar da ta ji rauni a matsayin da ka same ta — yi amfani da tsintsiya mai ƙarfi (itace, jarida da aka naɗe) wadda aka shimfiɗa da zane.

ig.text: Mee ka akụkụ ahụ merụrụ ahụ ghara imegharị n’ọnọdụ i hụrụ ya — jiri splint e ji ihe siri ike mee (osisi, akwụkwọ akụkọ a tụgharịrị) nke e ji akwa kpuchie.

yo.text: Dá ẹsẹ ọwọ tàbi ẹsẹ ti o farapa duro ni ipo ti o ti ri i — lo ohun ìtìlẹ́yìn ti a ṣe pẹlu ohun elo líle (igi, ìwé ìròyìn tí a yí ká) tí a fi aṣọ rọ̀.

pcm.text: Hold the injured hand or leg for the position wey you see am—use splint wey strong material like wood or rolled newspaper, and wrap cloth around am.

steps.en: If bone is through skin, cover with a clean cloth. Do not push it back.

ha.text: Idan ƙashi ya fito ta fata, rufe shi da zane mai tsafta. Kada ka mayar da shi ciki.

ig.text: Ọ bụrụ na ọkpụkpụ apụtala n’akpụkpọ ahụ, jiri akwa dị ọcha kpuchie ya. Etyghachila ya n’ime.

yo.text: Bí egungun bá já síta nípasẹ̀ awọ ara, fi aṣọ mímọ́ bò ó. Má ṣe tì í padà sínú.

pcm.text: If bone come out through skin, cover am with clean cloth. No push am go back.

steps.en: Apply an ice pack wrapped in cloth to reduce swelling. Do not apply ice directly to skin.

ha.text: Ka sanya kankara da aka naɗe cikin zane don rage kumburi. Kada a sa kankara kai tsaye a fata.

ig.text: Tinye akpa ice e ji akwa kechie n’ebe ahụ merụrụ iji belata ọzịza. Etinyela ice kpọmkwem n’akpụkpọ ahụ.

yo.text: Fi àpò yìnyín tí a fi aṣọ dì sí i láti dín wíwù kù. Má ṣe fi yìnyín kan awọ ara tààrà.

pcm.text: Put ice pack wey cloth wrap around am to reduce swelling. No put ice directly for skin.

steps.en: Elevate the injured limb if possible to reduce swelling.

ha.text: Ka ɗaga gaɓar da ta ji rauni idan zai yiwu domin rage kumburi.

ig.text: Welie akụkụ ahụ merụrụ ahụ ma ọ bụrụ na o kwere omume iji belata ọzịza.

yo.text: Gbé ẹ̀yà ara tí ó farapa sókè bí ó bá ṣeé ṣe láti dín wíwù kù.

pcm.text: Raise the injured hand or leg if e possible, make swelling reduce.

steps.en: Transport to hospital carefully, keeping the limb still.

ha.text: Ka kai shi asibiti a hankali, kana tabbatar da cewa gaɓar ba ta motsi.

ig.text: Kpachara anya buru onye ahụ gaa ụlọ ọgwụ, ka akụkụ ahụ ahụ ghara imegharị.

yo.text: Gbé lọ sí ilé ìwòsàn pẹ̀lú ìṣọ́ra, kí ẹ̀yà ara náà má bàa lọ.

pcm.text: Carry dem go hospital carefully, make the injured hand or leg no move.

steps.en: Call emergency services immediately (112 or 767).

ha.text: Kira ayyukan gaggawa nan da nan (112 ko 767).

ig.text: Kpọọ ndị ọrụ mberede ozugbo (112 ma ọ bụ 767).

yo.text: Pe awọn iṣẹ pajawiri lẹsẹkẹsẹ (112 tabi 767).

pcm.text: Abeg, call emergency services sharp sharp (112 or 767).

steps.en: Check for responsiveness — tap shoulder, shout "Are you okay?"

ha.text: Duba ko yana amsawa — taɓa kafadarsa, ka ce da ƙarfi, "Kana lafiya?"

ig.text: Lelee ma onye ahụ na-aza — kụọ ya n’ubu, tie mkpu, “Ị dị mma?”

yo.text: Ṣàyẹ̀wò bóyá ẹni náà ń fèsì — fọwọ́ kan èjìká rẹ̀, kí ó sì ké pé, “Ṣé ó wà dáadáa?”

pcm.text: Check if the person dey respond — tap their shoulder, shout, "You dey okay?"

steps.en: Begin chest compressions: place heel of hand on centre of chest, push down hard and fast — 100–120 per minute.

ha.text: Fara matsa kirji: sanya tafin hannunka a tsakiyar ƙirji, ka matsa ƙasa da ƙarfi da sauri — sau 100–120 a minti ɗaya.

ig.text: Malite ịpị obi: tinye ikiri aka gị n’etiti obi, pịa ya ike na ngwa ngwa — ugboro 100–120 kwa nkeji.

yo.text: Béré ìfọwọ́fà àyà: fi àtẹ́lẹwọ́ rẹ̀ sí àárín àyà, tẹ̀ mọ́lẹ̀ gidigidi àti kíákíá — ìgbà 100–120 nínú ìṣẹ́jú kan.

pcm.text: Start chest compressions: put the heel of your hand for the middle of their chest, press am down hard and fast — 100–120 times per minute.

steps.en: After 30 compressions, give 2 rescue breaths (tilt head back, lift chin, seal mouth, blow in).

ha.text: Bayan matsawa sau 30, ba da numfashin ceto 2 (mayar da kai baya, ɗaga haɓa, rufe baki da naka, ka hura iska).

ig.text: Mgbe ịpịchara obi ugboro 30, nye ume mgbapụta 2 (tugharia isi azụ, bulie agba, mechie ọnụ, fụọ ume n’ime).

yo.text: Lẹ́yìn ìdáfíta 30, fún un ní ẹ̀mí ìrànlọ́wọ́ méjì (fẹ́ orí rẹ̀ sẹ́yìn, gbé  agbọn rẹ̀ sókè, di ẹnu mọ́ ẹnu rẹ̀, kí ó sì fẹ́ ẹ̀mí sínú rẹ̀).

pcm.text: After 30 compressions, give 2 rescue breaths (bend their head back, lift their chin, cover their mouth with your mouth, blow air inside).

steps.en: Continue 30:2 cycle until emergency services arrive or person recovers.

ha.text: Ci gaba da zagayen 30:2 har ayyukan gaggawa su iso ko mutumin ya farfaɗo.

ig.text: Gaa n’ihu na usoro 30:2 ruo mgbe ndị ọrụ mberede rutere ma ọ bụ onye ahụ agbakee.

yo.text: Tẹ̀síwájú pẹ̀lú ìyípo 30:2 títí àwọn iṣẹ́ pàjáwìrì yóò fi dé tàbí ẹni náà yóò fi padà láradá.

pcm.text: Continue the 30:2 cycle until emergency services reach there or the person recover.

steps.en: Use an AED if available — turn it on and follow the voice instructions.

ha.text: Yi amfani da AED idan akwai — kunna shi kuma bi umarnin murya.

ig.text: Jiri AED ma ọ bụrụ na ọ dị — gbanye ya ma soro ntuziaka olu.

yo.text: Lo AED bí ó bá wá — tán an, kí o sì tẹ̀lé àwọn ìtọ́nisọ́nà ọ̀hún.

pcm.text: Use AED if e dey available — switch am on and follow the voice instructions.

steps.en: Ask the person 'Are you choking?' If they cannot answer or cough, act immediately.

ha.text: Tambayi mutumin, “Kana shaƙewa?” Idan ba zai iya amsawa ko tari ba, ɗauki mataki nan da nan.

ig.text: Jụọ onye ahụ, “Ị na-ata ahụhụ n’ihi nri jidere gị n’akpịrị?” Ọ bụrụ na ha enweghị ike ịza ma ọ bụ ụkwara, mee ngwa ngwa.

yo.text: Béèrè lọ́wọ́ ẹni náà pé, “Ṣé o ń hó nǹkan?" Tí wọn kò bá lè dáhùn tàbí kó, ṣe ohun kan lẹ́sẹ̀kẹsẹ̀.

pcm.text: Ask the person, “You dey choke?” If dem no fit answer or cough, act sharp sharp.

steps.en: Give 5 back blows. Stand behind them, bend them forward, and hit them firmly between the shoulder blades.

ha.text: Yi masa bugun baya sau 5. Tsaya a bayansa, ka lanƙwasa shi gaba, sannan ka buga masa da ƙarfi tsakanin ƙashin kafadunsa.

ig.text: Kụọ ha ihe ugboro 5 n’azụ. Guzoro n’azụ ha, hulata ha n’ihu, ma kụọ ha ike n’etiti ọkpụkpụ ubu.

yo.text: Lu ẹ̀yìn wọn ní ìgbà márùn-ún. Dúró lẹ́yìn wọ́n síwájú, kí ó sì lù wọ́n dáadáa láàárín egungun èjìká.

pcm.text: Give dem 5 blows for back. Stand behind dem, bend dem forward, and hit dem well well between their shoulder blades.

steps.en: If the blockage doesn't clear, give 5 abdominal thrusts (Heimlich maneuver).

ha.text: Idan abin da ya toshe bai fita ba, yi masa matsin ciki sau 5 (Heimlich maneuver).

ig.text: Ọ bụrụ na ihe jidere akpịrị ahụ apụghị ịpụ, mee mkpali afọ ugboro 5 (Heimlich maneuver).

yo.text: Tí ohun tó dì wọ́n kò bá jà, ṣe ìfẹ́sẹ́mú inú ìgbà márùn-ún (lànà Heimlich).

pcm.text: If the blockage no clear, give dem 5 abdominal thrusts (Heimlich maneuver).

steps.en: Alternate between 5 back blows and 5 abdominal thrusts until the blockage is dislodged.

ha.text: Riƙa musanya tsakanin bugun baya sau 5 da matsin ciki sau 5 har sai abin da ya toshe ya fita.

ig.text: Na-atụgharị n’etiti ịkụ azụ ugboro 5 na mkpali afọ ugboro 5 ruo mgbe ihe ahụ jidere akpịrị apụta.

yo.text: Máa yí padà láàárín lílu eyín ìgbà márùn-ún àti ìfẹ̀sọ̀mù inú ìgbà márùn-ún títí ohun tó di wọn yóò fi já.

pcm.text: Dey alternate between 5 back blows and 5 abdominal thrusts until the blockage comot.

steps.en: If the person becomes unconscious, lower them to the ground and begin CPR.

ha.text: Idan mutumin ya suma, kwantar da shi a ƙasa sannan ka fara CPR.

ig.text: Ọ bụrụ na onye ahụ amaghịzi onwe ya, dọba ya n’ala ma malite CPR.

yo.text: Tí ẹni náà bá dákú, sọ wọ́n sílẹ̀ lórí ilẹ̀, kí ó sì bẹ̀rẹ̀ CPR.

pcm.text: If the person lose consciousness, lay dem for ground and start CPR.

steps.en: Encourage the child to cough — if they can cough forcefully, let them.

ha.text: Ƙarfafa yaron ya yi tari — idan zai iya yin tari da ƙarfi, bari ya yi.

ig.text: Gbaa nwa ahụ ume ka ọ kwụ ụkwara — ọ bụrụ na ọ nwere ike ịkwara ike, hapụ ya ka ọ kwụọ ụkwara.

yo.text: Gba ọmọ náà níyànjú láti kọ́ — bí wọ́n bá lè kọ́ gidigidi, jẹ́ kí wọ́n ṣe bẹ́ẹ̀.

pcm.text: Encourage di pikin make e cough — if e fit cough well-well, make e cough.

steps.en: Lean the child forward and give 5 firm back blows between the shoulder blades with the heel of your hand.

ha.text: Tanƙwasa yaron gaba sannan ka yi masa bugun baya masu ƙarfi sau 5 a tsakanin ƙasusuwan kafada da tafin hannunka.

ig.text: Kpọọ nwa ahụ ihu n’ala ma kụọ ya azụ ugboro 5 n’etiti ubu ya site n’ikiri aka gị.

yo.text: Jẹ́ kí ọmọ náà tẹ̀ síwájú, kí ó sì fún un ní ìfọwọ́gbẹ̀ ẹ̀yìn tó lágbára márùn-ún láàárín àwọn èjìká pẹ̀lú atẹ́lẹsẹ̀ ọ̀wọ́ rẹ̀.

pcm.text: Bend di pikin forward and give am 5 firm blows for back, between di shoulder blades, with di heel of your hand.

steps.en: If back blows fail: give 5 abdominal thrusts — kneel behind the child, make a fist above the navel, thrust inward and upward.

ha.text: Idan bugun baya bai yi tasiri ba: yi masa matsa ciki sau 5 — durƙusa a bayan yaron, ka haɗa hannu ka yi dunƙule sama da cibiya, sannan ka matsa ciki da sama.

ig.text: Ọ bụrụ na ịkụ azụ adịghị arụ ọrụ: nye ya nrụgide afọ ugboro 5 — gbuo ikpere n’azụ nwa ahụ, mee aka gị ọkpọ n’elu otubo, pịakwaa n’ime na n’elu.
